tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dzambha la ser po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ bsam pa thams cad rdo rje longs spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyom par bzhugs nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo'i tshul 'di nyid kyi sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*// dzam̐/ sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa dag /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su bsam// sangs rgyas kun gyi cho ga yis// rdo rje bsgom pas dbab par bya// dzambha la ni nor sgrub pa// gnod sbyin chen po bskyed par bya// zhi ba gnod sbyin gzugs 'dzin pa// thor tshugs dbu rgyan rdo rje can// sangs rgyas lnga yi cho ga yis// gnas lnga dag tu bsgom par bya// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu de yis// bsam gtan gnas la 'dug la dbul// rdo rje sems dpa'i cho ga yis// dbu rgyan de la rnam par bsam// de ltar byas na gnod sbyin dbang*// gnod gnas dbang po 'od chen mnyes// rdo rje dam tshig gi phyag rgya rdzas sgrub pa'i tog gi dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// zhes bya ba ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu drug pa las so// ༈ /de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ nor dang 'bru thams cad la sems pa ni bsam pa thams cad de

thams cad la bsam pa ste sems shing re ba'o// gang zag de rdo rje dang 'dra bar thogs pa med par longs spyod cing dmigs par ste skyong bar byed pas na/ rdo rje longs spyod pa ste de skad ces bya ba la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo'i tshul zhes bya ba/ gnod gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par sa bon gang gis bskyed pa 'di/ nyid kyi sku la sogs pa las phyung ngo*// dzam̐ ni dzambha la zhes pa'i ming yig dang bo dza la ma yig klad kor du byin pa'o// de la dzambhani rmugs pa dang*/ la ni len pa'am 'dzin pa yin pa la bsams nas rmugs 'dzin du bsgyur/ yang dzambha la nges tshig gis stambha gnon pa dang*/ a lā ya zhes pa gnas yin pa la bsams nas gnod gnas su sgyur/ kha cig gis rmugs pa'i sgo nas gnod pa byed pa la bsams nas gnod gnas su bsgyur ro// sangs rgyas zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su gnas par ni stong par bsgom pa'o/ /de'i ngang nas sangs rgyas te ni gnod nas so/ /gnod gnas de nyid 'dir snying po gyur pas na dkyil lo/ /maṇḍa la'i ni snying po de len cing skyed pas na sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor te sa bon dzam̐ yig pad zla'i steng du bsam mo/ no// de la sangs rgyas 'gyur rnying sangs rgyas kun gyi cho ga yis// zhes pa las/ cho ga yis ni sangs rgyas kun// zhes pa bde ro/ kun zhes bya ba ni gser la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rigs dang ldan pa ste der gtogs pa thams cad 'o/ cho ga yis ka zhes bya ba sa bon dzam̐ yig las 'od zer spro sa pas ba dang bsdu ba'i sbyor bas rdo rje ste gnod gnas sgom pa pos sa bon la dbab par bya zhing nang du bstim par bya 'o/ ste/ sa bon de yongs su gyur pa las bī dza pū ra dzam̐ gyis mtshan pa/

de las gnod sbyin chen po gnod gnas gser gyi mdog can gsus pa che ba mi'u thung gi gzugs can zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa lag pa g.yas rnams kyis bī dza pū ra dang lcags kyu dang mda' thogs pa/ g.yon rnams las gcig gis te dang pos rang gi rig ma rang dang 'dra ba la 'khyud pa la brtson pa g.yon gyi gzhan 'og ma gnyis kyis zhags pa bzang po dang bcas pa'i ne'u le dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ thor tshugs dang dbu rgyan du rdo rje can te rdo rje 'chang yod pa 'di lta bu'i tshul du/ bdag nyid gnod gnas su rdzas sgrub pa la bsgom par bya zhing*/ sangs rgyas lnga zhes bya ba rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa/ cho ga yis zhes bya ba rim gyis mgo ba dang lkog ma dang snying ga dang lte ba dang byin pa rnams su/ oṃ la sogs pa'i sa bon las byung ba bsgom par bya'o// de nas rang gi mdun du rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du rang gi snying ga las rang dang 'dra ba'i gnod gnas byung la bstim snga ma bdag bskyed bzhin du stong par sbyangs pa sogs thams cad byas nas mdun gyi de'i cod pan du bde ba chen po rdo rje 'chang*/ rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes pa dang*/ yi ge dzam̐ las byang chub kyi sems zhes so sor bshad dgos pa'i dang po'i don ni/ rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar bsams la zhes pa'o// gnyis pa'i don ni gnod gnas de'i mgor chu'i skad dod dza la zhes pa'i ming yig dang po la thig le byin pa'i yi ge las chu byang chub kyi sems kyi rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu ra bskyed la/ oṃ dzambha la dza dza la ni chu'o/ ind+ra ni dbang po'i

lend+rā ya swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'don pa sngon du 'gro bas bsgoms la sbyin par bya'o// de ltar sbyin pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cho ga yis// dbu rgyan de la rnam par bsam// zhes bya ba'o// de ltar byas pas ni de mnyes shing sgrub pa po'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do// rdo rje'i phyag rgya ni mi phyed pa'i gnod gnas kyi phyag rgya'o// de nyid 'da' bar mi bya bas na dam tshig go /des rdzas sgrub pa'i rdzas skyed pa'o// de nyid ni tog dang ldan par mtho zhing dpal te nus pa dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang yin pa de la yang de skad ces bya'o// zhes slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba las phyung ba ste rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung mchan dang bcas pa'o// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin gnod gnas kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dzambha la'i sgo nas nor bsgrub par 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du dzaṃ las bī dza pū ra dzam̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ gser la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rigs thams cad bsdus nas de la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gnod sbyin dzambha la gser gyi mdog can rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyis dbur brgyan pa ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum gyis bī dza pū ra dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ mda'/ g.yon gsum gyis rang 'dra'i yum la khyud cing*/ zhags pa bzang po dang bcas pa'i ne'u le dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ gsus pa che ba/ mi'u thung gi gzugs can/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ las rnam snang*/

mgrin par āḥlas 'od dpag med/ thugs kar hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa/ lte bar swā las rin 'byung*/ brla'i rtsa bar hā las don yod grub pa/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyis byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur/ rang gi mdun du rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du padma dang zla ba'i steng du zhes pa nas/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bsgoms nas/ rang gi snying ga nas rang 'dra'i dzambha la byung*/ mdun bskyed kyi dzambha la la thim/ rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i byang sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur zhing*/ dzam̐ las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dzambha la'i mgo bor khrus gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya swā hā/ zhes chu sbyin par bya'o// de nas mchod pa dngos su bshams yod na byin rlabs spyi ltar bya/ oṃ ārya dzambha la arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gser gyi mdog can nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od// nor gyi dbang phyug gter 'chang kun gyi bdag /sgrub pa po la ci 'dod dngos grub kun// myur du stsol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dbul phongs dang bral nas chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ sgrub pa po la dgyes bzhin du bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas nas rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ chu thigs pa gcig dngos grub blang ba'i tshul du lce la bzhag go /bsngo ba bya'o// 'di ni chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i man ngag bzhin du dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang pos bkod pa'o//

༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin gnod gnas kyi rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dzambha lā ya/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu drug pa nas gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin gnod gnas kyi rjes su gnang ba ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par byi dor byas la/ bris sku sogs kyi rten yod na bkram pa'i spyan sngar stegs bu'i dbus su rjes gnang gi bsgrub gzhi khang bu brtsegs pa sum brtsegs rin po che'i rgyan dang bcas pa/ de'i mdun du 'bul gtor zlum po rgyan ldan dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma/ mchod pa'i nyer spyod/ chu sbyin gyi snod rten dang bcas pa dang*/ chu gtsang*/ gzhan yang rdor dril 'thor nas sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar byas la/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ rang gi snying gar thim par gyur ces pa'i bar gyis bdag mdun gsal gdab cing*/ mdun bskyed la 'di 'og mdun bskyed skabs sbrel kyang rung chu sbyin nas rang la bstim pa rnams rgyal ba dge 'dun gyi grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blangs mthar/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du dzam̐ yig ser po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal/ lha dang mi'i rin po che thams cad bsdus te dbang du byas par bsams la/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas shing 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ mdun rten bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa sum brtsegs su gnas pa'i dbus ma la gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs padma dang*/

a las zla ba'i steng du dzam̐ las sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'phags pa dzambha la'i rnam par spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed kyi dzambha la la thim/ rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las mchod rdzas rnams rang bzhin bde stong*/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las zag med kyi bde ba skyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shabda'i bar gyis brlab/ oṃ ārya dzambha la arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ gser gyi mdog can sogs kyis bstod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar sngags phreng gsal btab la 'od zer spro bsdu dang bcas bzlas pa cung zad bya/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ ārya dzambha la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin mthar/ 'phags pa dzambha las bdag dang sems can thams cad sogs 'dod gsol dang*/ bdag gi rdo rje'i slob ma rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gzhi bdag gtor ma spyi ltar gtong ngo*// gnyis pa rjes gnang dngos ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas te tshogs pa na/ bgegs bsal/ srung 'khor bsgom/ me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/

slob dpon gyis nges 'byung dang*/ byang chub sems kyi gtam zab mos rgyud 'khul bar byas te/ mtshams sbyor gyi khyad par/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen pos rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas/ gnas skabs su mtho ris yon tan bdun gyi khyad par log pa'i 'tsho ba dang bral ba'i dpal 'byor longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang 'byor pas rang dang*/ gzhan gyi phan bde'i don thams cad dka' ba med par sgrub pa dang*/ mthar thug gi 'gro ba mtha' dag gi re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la sbyar ba'i slad du gnod sbyin nor lha'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las 'dir rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud sde thams cad kyi snying po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu drug pa nas gsungs shing*/ grub pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis tshul 'di la brten nas gnod sbyin dbang po mngon sum du grub pas 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa ji ltar bzhed bzhin bsgrubs pas mtshon te/ mdor na slob dpon a bhā yas/ thun mtshams gsum du bsgoms nas chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad rab tu phul bas 'jig rten gsum gyi mnga' ris ster bar byed do// snga bar bya rog skad sgrog pa tsam na chu'i nang du bzlas na nor mi nyams shing 'phel bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ dngos grub chen po brgyad la sogs pa ster bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par 'phags bod du dngos grub brnyes pa mang du byon pa'i byin rlabs can/ gnod sbyin gnod gnas ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ chos snang ba'i sgo dad pa dang nges shes khyad par can bskyed nas thog mar zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ zhes pa lta bu brda sprad la maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

kun mkhyen ye shes ye shes phung po can// sogs lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon rang nyid kyang tha mal gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu ma yin par 'phags pa dzambha la dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ mdun gyi rten gtor kyang bsgrubs zin pa ltar/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa sum brtsegs su gnas pa'i dbus ma la gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan la 'phags pa dzambha la gser gyi mdog can sogs nas/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ gnas lngar de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas mtshan pa la/ gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin gyi phung po thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas/ byang chub yid kyis gzung*/ rjes gnang gi gzhi bsgrub pa'i slad du/ swa bhā wa sogs/ slob ma rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur ces pa'i bar gyis gsal gdab/ de nas rjes gnang dngos la/ thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku yi rdo rje slob dpon gyis// bdag la gnod sbyin gnod gnas kyi// sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab cing gus 'dud mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'phags pa dzambha la'i rnam par spyan drangs/ de dang lhan cig tu mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pa'i sku las kyang sku dpag tu med pa byung*/

slob ma rnams kyi lus la char chen po babs pa bzhin sib sib thim par gyur/ sngags bzla zhing spos rol bya/ des lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ slob ma'i lus dang gnod sbyin gnod gnas kyi sku dbyer med du gyur pa ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gong gi tshig la/ gsung gi rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang zhes sbyar ba lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad 'phags pa dzambha la'i sngags phreng gi rnam par spyan drangs/ de dang lhan cig tu mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pa'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las kyang sngags phreng gnyis pa re byung*/ zhal nas 'thon/ rang rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zla gdan la dzam̐ yig gi mthar 'khod/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ brtan g.yo'i bcud dang dge mtshan thams cad bkug nas rang gi bang mdzod sogs phyur bur gang ba'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sngags lan gsum/ des ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ slob ma'i ngag dang gnod sbyin gnod gnas kyi gsung dbyer med du gyur pa ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ thugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon dang*// thugs kyi rjes gnang zhes sbyar ba lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'phags pa dzambha la'i phyag mtshan dang*/ sa bon dzam̐ yig ser po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ de dang lhan cig tu mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang phyag mtshan dang*/

sa bon gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ slob ma rnams kyi snying gar sib sib thim pas/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ slob ma'i yid dang gnod sbyin gnod gnas kyi thugs dbyer med du gyur pa ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas dngos grub kyi slad du chu sbyin dbul bar bya ba yin te zhes mtshams sbyar la/ rang gi mdun du rin po che'i snod sogs sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar slob ma la 'bul du gzhug pa'am/ slob ma'i ched du dmigs nas slob dpon gyis dbul/ de ltar chu phul bas mnyes shing tshim nas bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dngos grub bstsal ba'i mthar/ mdun bskyed kyi lha slob ma rnams kyi snying gar thim par gyur par bsam/ mtha' rten gtor ma la brten nas dbang lha bstim pa'i rjes gnang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor byon nas byin gyis brlabs par mos te/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// dus 'di ni bzung nas ni// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rkyen ngan bar chad sel ba dang*// ci 'dod dngos grub ma lus pa// da lta nyid du stsal du gsol// sngags kyi mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ brjod cing spyi bor bzhag pas/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba las rang 'dra ba gnyis pa byung*/ 'od du zhu nas slob ma rnams la thim pas/ slob ma rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ gnod sbyin gnod gnas kyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ spro na shis brjod rgyas par bya/ mjug gi bya ba dam tshig khas blang ba sogs spyi ltar ro// gsum pa rjes ni/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/

rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ bsngo smon shis brjod sogs byas la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// tshul 'di la gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi man ngag las byung ba grub pa'i slob dpon shānti pa/ a bhā ya/ tha ga na sogs kyi bzhed pa cung zad mi 'dra ba dang*/ de'i sgrub thabs sgom lung bcas pa rin 'byung du bzhugs pa bcas bka' srol gzhan yang snang mod/ 'dir ni gtso bor 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi man ngag gi rjes su 'brang ba'o// zhes pa'ang mang du thos pa ltar snang ba'i bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos/ rjes gnang gi yig cha rnying pa'i dgongs don gtso bor bzung zhing 'jug bde snying por dril ba'i tshul gyis sbyar ba ste/ 'dis kyang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal 'byor longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod kyi dga' ston la longs spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
